d: Na Indonésia existe uma figura do folclore que parece ter saído diretamente de um pesadelo: o Pocong. 👻🇮🇩 Segundo a lenda, o Pocong seria o espírito de uma pessoa morta que permanece preso ao próprio kafan, o tecido utilizado para envolver o corpo durante o funeral. A tradição conta que os nós do tecido deveriam ser desfeitos após o sepultamento, e quando isso não acontece, o espírito ficaria preso à mortalha. É por isso que as representações do Pocong mostram uma figura completamente coberta por um pano branco, com o corpo amarrado e se movimentando de uma maneira bastante peculiar. Em algumas histórias, ele aparece pulando ou se deslocando rigidamente durante a noite. 😨 A criatura se tornou uma das figuras mais conhecidas do terror e do folclore sobrenatural da Indonésia, aparecendo em filmes, histórias populares e relatos de supostos encontros. Se você encontrasse um desses no meio da noite… provavelmente nem lembraria como correr. 😂 Pocong, Pocong Indonésia, folclore indonésio, espíritos da Indonésia, lendas sobrenaturais, cultura indonésia, terror asiático, lendas urbanas, fantasmas, criaturas assustadoras. #Pocong #Folclore #Terror #Curiosidades #Paranormal
zh: 在印度尼西亚，有一个仿佛直接从噩梦中走出来的民间传说形象：Pocong。根据传说，Pocong是一个死者的灵魂，被困在自己的裹尸布里，也就是葬礼上用来包裹尸体的布料。传统说法是，裹尸布的结应该在下葬后被解开，如果没有解开，灵魂就会被困在寿衣里。这就是为什么对Pocong的描绘都是一个全身被白布覆盖、身体被捆绑着、并以一种非常奇特方式移动的形象。在一些故事中，它会在夜间跳跃或僵硬地移动。这种生物已成为印度尼西亚最著名的超自然恐怖和民间传说形象之一，出现在电影、民间故事和所谓的目击报告中。如果你半夜遇到一个这东西……你大概会吓得连怎么跑都忘了。Pocong，印尼Pocong，印尼民间传说，印尼幽灵，超自然传说，印尼文化，亚洲恐怖，都市传说，鬼魂，吓人生物。

d: ⚠️ THEY SAY IF YOU SEE SOMETHING WHITE HOPPING TOWARD YOU IN THE DARK… DON’T WAIT TO SEE ITS FACE. 👁️🇮🇩 Tonight’s nightmare is: THE POCONG. One of Indonesia’s most recognizable ghosts. But first… IS THE POCONG ACTUALLY REAL? There is no scientific evidence proving that dead bodies rise from graves as supernatural Pocong. But stories about the Pocong have been passed throughout Indonesia for generations. 🌑 THE REAL LEGEND In Indonesian Muslim burial tradition, the deceased is wrapped in a white burial shroud called a kafan. In Pocong folklore… something goes wrong. The spirit does not peacefully leave. Instead, it remains trapped or connected to the body’s burial shroud. And because the legs are wrapped together… the ghost doesn’t walk normally. IT HOPS. 😳 Stories commonly describe: ⚪ A body completely wrapped in white cloth 👁️ A partially exposed pale or frightening face 🪢 Knotted burial cloth 🦘 Moving by hopping 🌙 Appearing late at night ⚰️ Wandering near cemeteries, roads or lonely places Some stories say the Pocong appears because something was left unresolved after death. (ResearchGate) 👀 FACT THAT MAY SURPRISE YOU The word Pocong itself is connected with being wrapped in a burial shroud. So unlike a zombie whose body simply rises from the grave… the Pocong’s entire appearance comes directly from burial imagery. And despite looking almost funny when you hear: “A hopping ghost…” imagine actually seeing one coming toward you at midnight. 😭 THUMP. Silence. THUMP. Closer. ⚰️ THE UNTIED SHROUD LEGEND A popular modern version of the folklore says the knots of the burial shroud must be properly released after burial. If they are not… the deceased may become a Pocong and return looking for someone to free them. Versions differ from community to community, so this should be understood as folklore—not a universal religious teaching. 🎬 POCONG BECAME A HORROR ICON Pocong became HUGE in Indonesian popular culture. You’ll find it in: 🎥 Horror movies 📺 Television 📖 Ghost stories 👻 Haunted attractions 😂 Even comedy and pranks Researchers studying Indonesian horror films found Pocong among the most frequently appearing ghost figures in movie titles. (ResearchGate) 🌎 WHERE DO POCONG STORIES COME FROM? 🇮🇩 INDONESIA Pocong stories are widespread rather than tied to one single village. Depending on the storyteller, sightings happen around: ⚰️ Cemeteries 🌳 Banana trees 🛣️ Empty roads 🏚️ Abandoned buildings 🌙 Quiet neighborhoods after dark 👁️ SO WHERE CAN YOU LOCATE A POCONG? Scientifically? NOWHERE CONFIRMED. There is no verified cemetery where researchers have proven supernatural Pocong exist. You can experience the folklore through Indonesian culture, stories and horror traditions… but you’re exploring the LEGEND. Not hunting a scientifically documented ghost. Now imagine this… 🌙 2:06 AM. You’re walking beside a quiet cemetery in Indonesia. No cars. No people. Then… THUMP. You stop. Nothing. THUMP. You shine your flashlight toward the graves. A white figure is standing between two headstones. Completely wrapped in cloth. You freeze. Then— THUMP. It jumps closer. THUMP. Closer again. You finally see its face. Its eyes are already looking directly at you. 😳😳😳 WHAT ARE YOU DOING?! A) RUNNING 🏃💨 B) Never looking back 😭 C) Recording everything 📱 D) The Pocong can keep the whole cemetery 😂 Would you rather spend ONE NIGHT in a cemetery with a Pocong… OR… ONE NIGHT somewhere the Pontianak is said to wander? 👁️ 👇 PICK ONE. Our folklore horror journey continues: ✅ WENDIGO ✅ SKINWALKER ✅ JERSEY DEVIL ✅ BIGFOOT ✅ CHUPACABRA ✅ BELL WITCH ✅ LA LLORONA ✅ HOPKINSVILLE GOBLINS ✅ ASWANG ✅ PONTIANAK ✅ BANSHEE ✅ BABA YAGA ✅ CHUREL ✅ EL CUCO ✅ GASHADOKURO ✅ TIKBALANG ✅ KRAMPUS ✅ RUSALKA ✅ JIANGSHI ✅ EL SILBÓN ✅ KAPPA ✅ PISHTACO ✅ THE MARE ✅ YŪREI ✅ ONI ✅ ENCANTADO ✅ KELPIE ✅ ADZE ✅ ACHERI ✅ DOPPELGÄNGER ✅ THE ALP ✅ THE PÚCA ✅ BLACK SHUCK ✅ LA SIGUANABA ✅ CURUPIRA ✅ FLATWOODS MONSTER ✅ MAE NAK ✅ POCONG 🇮🇩 ✅ KHMER AHP 🇰🇭 SAVE this before tonight. SEND it to the friend who thinks a hopping ghost sounds funny. 😭 Because hearing “it hops” sounds ridiculous… UNTIL Y
zh: 如果黑暗中看见一个白色东西跳向你，别等着看它的脸。今夜噩梦：Pocong。印尼最知名的鬼魂之一。但首先……Pocong真的存在吗？没有科学证据证明尸体会作为超自然的Pocong从坟墓里爬起来。但关于Pocong的故事在印尼代代相传。真实的传说：在印尼穆斯林的丧葬传统中，逝者会用称为kafan的白布包裹。在Pocong的民间传说里……出了点问题。灵魂没有平静离去，而是被困在或连接着身上的裹尸布。因为双脚被绑在一起……鬼魂无法正常行走，而是跳着走。故事通常描述：全身被白布包裹的身体、部分露出的苍白或可怕的脸、系着结的裹尸布、跳跃移动、深夜出现、在墓地、路边或偏僻之地游荡。有些故事说，Pocong出现是因为死后还有未了之事。可能让你惊讶的事实：Pocong这个词本身就与裹尸布捆绑有关。所以不像僵尸仅仅是尸体从坟墓里爬起来……Pocong的整个形象直接源于丧葬意象。尽管当你听到“一个跳着走的鬼……”时觉得有点滑稽，但想象一下午夜真的看到一个朝你跳过来。砰。静默。砰。更近了。解开的裹尸布传说：一个流行的现代传说版本说，下葬后裹尸布的结必须被正确解开。如果没有……逝者可能变成Pocong回来找人帮他们解开。各地说法不一，所以这应被理解为民间传说，而非普遍的宗教教义。Pocong成了恐怖标志：Pocong在印尼流行文化中变得非常火爆。你会在恐怖电影、电视、鬼故事、鬼屋景点乃至喜剧和恶作剧里找到它。研究印尼恐怖电影的学者发现，Pocong是电影片名中最常出现的鬼怪形象之一。Pocong故事从何而来？印度尼西亚：Pocong故事广泛流传，而非局限于某一个村庄。根据讲述者的不同，目击事件发生在墓地、香蕉树、空无一人的道路、废弃建筑、天黑后安静的街区。那么你在哪里能找到Pocong？科学上说，没有确认的地方。没有哪个墓地能证实超自然的Pocong存在。你可以通过印尼文化、故事和恐怖传统来体验这个传说……但你在探索的是传说，不是追踪一个科学记录的鬼魂。现在想象一下……凌晨2点06分，你走在印尼一处安静的墓园旁边。没有车，没有人。然后……砰。你停下来，什么都没有。砰。你用手电筒照向坟墓。一个白色身影站在两块墓碑之间，全身裹着布。你僵住了。然后——砰。它跳近了一些。砰。又近了。你终于看到它的脸，它的眼睛已经直直地盯着你。你怎么办？A) 跑 B) 永不回头 C) 录下一切 D) 整个墓地都给Pocong吧。你宁愿在墓地和一个Pocong待一晚，还是去传说中Pontianak出没的地方待一晚？选一个。我们的民间恐怖之旅继续。

d: "TEREKAM KAMERA! SOSOK MISTERIUS DI SUNGAI! 😨" "APAKAH INI... PENUNGGU SUNGAI YANG ASLI?" "MITOS ATAU FAKTA? KAMU HARUS LIHAT INI!" Guys, liat video ini! Diambil di lokasi yang dirahasiakan, tapi penampakannya... bener-bener bikin merinding! Sosok ini besar, gelap, dan samar-samar terlihat di bawah air keruh, persis di balik juntaian pohon gantung. Banyak yang bilang, di daerah sini ada legenda kuno tentang makhluk mitologi yang disebut "Naga Keruh" atau "Siluman Penjaga Akar". Konon, makhluk ini adalah perwujudan roh sungai yang sudah berumur ribuan tahun. [Bagian 2: Asal Usul & Sejarah Mitologi (Dramatis)] Menurut cerita turun-temurun, "Siluman Penjaga Akar" ini bukan hewan biasa. Dia adalah penjaga ekosistem sungai. Sejarahnya berasal dari masa di mana peradaban kuno hidup selaras dengan alam. Masyarakat dulu sangat menghormatinya. Ada pantangan: jangan pernah mengotori air atau menebang pohon di sekitar sungai, atau dia akan menampakkan diri untuk memberi peringatan... atau hal yang lebih buruk! [Bagian 3: Fakta Menarik & Sudut Pandang Ilmuwan (Skeptic tapi Penasaran)] Fakta menariknya: video ini tidak bisa dijelaskan dengan mudah. Tapi, apa kata ilmuwan? Para ahli biologi dan fisikawan yang melihat ini cenderung skeptis. Sudut pandang mereka? Ini adalah contoh klasik dari Pareidolia. Pareidolia adalah fenomena di mana otak manusia mencoba mencari pola atau bentuk yang familier (seperti wajah atau naga) dalam objek acak. Ilmuwan berteori kalau yang kita liat ini hanyalah:  * Akar pohon besar yang meliuk di bawah air.  * Arus sungai yang membuat bayangan pohon di atasnya terlihat bergerak aneh.  * Sampah organik atau batuan dasar sungai yang terkena cahaya samar. Otak kita cuma terprogram untuk melihat sesuatu yang menakutkan karena suasananya sudah mendukung! [Bagian 4: Pertanyaan Hook (Closing)] Jadi gimana menurut kalian? Apakah ini beneran Siluman Penjaga Akar yang bangkit dari tidurnya, atau cuma permainan cahaya dan bayangan dari alam? Kalian percaya mitos, atau penjelasan ilmuwan? Tulis pendapat kalian di kolom komentar dan bagikan video ini! 👇 Hashtags: #misteri #penampakan #mitologi #mitosvsfakta #legenda
zh: "被镜头拍到了！河中神秘身影！" "这真的是……真正的河之守护者吗？" "传说还是事实？你必须要看一看！" 伙计们，快看这个视频！拍摄于一个秘密地点，但那个显影……真的让人毛骨悚然！这个身影巨大、黑暗，在浑浊的水下若隐若现，正好就在垂挂的树根后面。很多人说，这里有个古老的传说，关于一种叫"浊龙"或"护根精"的神话生物。据说，这个生物是已有千年历史的河流之灵化身。 第2部分：起源与传说历史（戏剧化）： 根据代代相传的故事，这个"护根精"可不是普通动物。它是河流生态系统的守护者。其历史可追溯到古代文明与自然和谐共处的时期。以前的人们非常敬畏它。有一个禁忌：永远不要污染水源或砍伐河边的树木，否则它就会显灵发出警告……或者更糟的事情！ 第3部分：有趣的事实和科学家观点（怀疑但好奇）： 有趣的事实：这个视频很难轻易解释。但是，科学家们怎么说？看到这个视频的生物学家和物理学家倾向于持怀疑态度。他们的观点？这是典型的大脑空想性错视现象。空想性错视是指人脑试图在随机物体中寻找熟悉的图案或形状（比如脸或龙）。科学家推测，我们看到的只是： 水底摇曳的粗大树根。 水流使树影在水下看起来怪异移动。 有机垃圾或河底岩石在昏暗光线下形成的景象。 我们的大脑只是因为整体氛围到位，才被"编程"去看到可怕的东西！ 第4部分：钩子问题（结尾）： 所以，你们怎么看？这真的是从沉睡中苏醒的护根精，还是仅仅是自然的光影游戏？你们相信传说，还是科学家的解释？在评论区写下你们的看法，并分享这个视频！

zh: 诺亚方舟之谜再被研究。土耳其亚拉腊山附近的杜鲁皮纳尔遗址，因形似船形而再次成为使用雷达技术和钻探进行研究的对象。诺亚方舟扫描小组声称发现了地下类似走廊和房间的结构，将对此进行进一步研究。然而，此前一些地质学家表示，该构造是由侵蚀过程形成的自然地貌。为寻找诺亚方舟存在的相关证据，这项研究仍在进行中。

⚠️ THEY SAY THE MOST TERRIFYING THING ABOUT AN ASWANG IS… DURING THE DAY, IT MAY LOOK COMPLETELY HUMAN. 🇵🇭👁️ Tonight’s nightmare is: THE ASWANG. One of the most famous supernatural beings in Filipino folklore. But first… IS THE ASWANG ACTUALLY REAL? There is no scientific evidence proving supernatural shapeshifting Aswang exist. But belief in the Aswang has been part of Philippine folklore for generations. And here’s something many people outside the Philippines don’t realize… 🌑 THE REAL FOLKLORE “Aswang” doesn’t describe just ONE monster. It can be an umbrella term for different supernatural beings depending on the region and story. Some traditions describe an Aswang as a person who appears completely normal during the day… but transforms after dark. Stories may describe Aswang that: 🐕 Transform into animals 🦇 Fly through the night 🩸 Feed on blood 👁️ Hunt people after dark 😨 Consume internal organs 🌑 Hide among ordinary communities Some legends describe creatures associated with dogs, pigs or other animals. Others resemble witches or vampires. And some stories involve beings whose bodies can separate before flying into the night. That’s what makes the Aswang so terrifying: There is no single form you can recognize. 👀 FACT THAT MAY SURPRISE YOU People sometimes confuse the Aswang with the Manananggal. But they aren’t necessarily identical. The Manananggal is usually described as a specific creature that separates its upper body from its lower body and flies using wings. “Aswang” can refer to a MUCH wider group of supernatural beings. Another famous detail? The eerie nighttime sound: “TIK-TIK… TIK-TIK…” In some folklore, hearing the sound can mean an Aswang is nearby. And the creepiest version of the warning says… if the sound becomes QUIETER… the creature may actually be getting CLOSER. 😳 🇵🇭 WHERE DO ASWANG STORIES COME FROM? Stories appear throughout different parts of the Philippines. But Panay and Capiz became especially famous for Aswang folklore. Capiz has become so strongly associated with the legend that simply mentioning the province can bring up Aswang stories for many Filipinos. But remember: These are real communities filled with ordinary people. Folklore should never be used to label or harass anyone living there. 👁️ SO WHERE CAN YOU LOCATE AN ASWANG? Scientifically? NOWHERE CONFIRMED. There is no verified Aswang habitat or supernatural creature researchers can locate. You CAN visit places connected to Filipino Aswang traditions and learn about the folklore… but you’re searching for the STORIES and cultural history. Not a scientifically documented monster. Now imagine this… 🌙 1:27 AM. You’re staying in a quiet provincial house in the Philippines. Everyone is asleep. Then you hear something outside. TIK-TIK… You ignore it. TIK-TIK… It sounds farther away. Then suddenly… nothing. Complete silence. You walk toward the window. A dog is standing beneath a tree. Completely still. You shine your flashlight at it. It slowly turns toward you. But something about its face… doesn’t look right. Then from ABOVE your roof… you hear scratching. 😳 WHAT ARE YOU DOING?! A) Locking every door immediately 🔒 B) Calling the whole family 😭 C) Recording everything 📱 D) That house belongs to the Aswang now 😂 Would you rather spend ONE NIGHT somewhere connected to Aswang folklore… OR… ONE NIGHT beside a river listening for La Llorona? 👁️ 👇 PICK ONE. SEND it to your Filipino friend and ask: “Did your family ever warn you about the Aswang?” 😭 Because whether you believe the creature exists or not… the legend has survived through generations of Filipino storytelling. 🇵🇭👁️ #Aswang #FilipinoFolklore #HorrorTok #ScaryStories #Philippines
zh: 据说阿斯旺最恐怖之处在于，白天它可能看起来完全是个正常人。今晚的噩梦主题是阿斯旺，菲律宾民间传说中最著名的超自然存在之一。但阿斯旺真的存在吗？尚无科学证据证明会变形的阿斯旺真实存在，但其传说在菲律宾已流传数代。很多人不知道的是，阿斯旺并非单指一种怪物，而是一个涵盖不同地区、不同故事的超自然生物总称。有些传说描述阿斯旺白天完全正常，入夜后变形，能化为动物、夜飞、嗜血、猎食人类、吞噬内脏、潜藏于普通社区。有些传说将其与狗、猪等动物联系起来，另一些则类似女巫或吸血鬼，还有传说其身体会分离后再飞入夜空。这就是阿斯旺的恐怖之处，它没有固定的可辨识形态。人们常把阿斯旺和曼南加尔混淆，但它们并不完全等同，曼南加尔通常特指上身与下身分离并靠翅膀飞行的生物，而阿斯旺涵盖范围更广。另一个著名细节是夜里诡异的嘀嗒声，在某些传说中，听到这声音意味着阿斯旺就在附近。最可怕的警告是，如果声音变弱，它可能离你更近了。阿斯旺故事遍布菲律宾各地，但班乃岛和卡皮斯省尤其出名，甚至一提及该省就会让人联想到阿斯旺。但请记住，这些是普通人居住的真实社区，传说绝不能拿来给当地人贴标签或进行骚扰。科学上阿斯旺没有确认的存在地点，没有研究者能找到它的栖息地，你只能去那些与传说相关的地方了解故事和文化，而非寻找有科学记录的怪物。现在想象一下，凌晨一点二十七分，你独自住在菲律宾乡间安静的房子里，所有人都睡了。你听到外面传来嘀嗒声，你没理会，声音似乎飘远了。突然，一片死寂。你走向窗边，看见树下站着一只狗，纹丝不动。你用手电筒照过去，它缓缓转向你，但那张脸有些不对劲。这时，你头顶的屋顶上传来抓挠声。

d: 1. God hates gossip because it destroys relationships Proverbs 16:28 “A perverse person stirs up conflict, and a gossip separates close friends.” Why this matters: God values unity and peace. Gossip quietly pulls people apart—often people who once trusted each other. From God’s perspective, that damage is serious, not trivial. ⸻ 2. Gossip is treated as a serious sin, not a “small flaw” Romans 1:29–30 “They have become filled with every kind of wickedness… gossips, slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant…” Why this matters: Notice gossip is listed alongside major sins. Scripture doesn’t minimize it because it reflects a corrupt heart, not just careless speech. ⸻ 3. God holds people accountable for every careless word Matthew 12:36 “I tell you, on the day of judgment people will give account for every careless word they speak.” Why this matters: Gossip often starts as “careless talk.” Jesus makes it clear: words aren’t neutral. God cares deeply about how speech is used. ⸻ 4. Gossip comes from the wrong condition of the heart Matthew 15:18–19 “What comes out of the mouth proceeds from the heart… false witness, slander.” Why this matters: God focuses on the heart. Gossip isn’t just about information—it reveals envy, pride, resentment, or bitterness inside the speaker. ⸻ 5. God commands us to speak in ways that build, not tear down Ephesians 4:29 “Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up.” Why this matters: Gossip doesn’t build up. Even if it’s true, if it damages rather than heals, it violates God’s standard for speech. ⸻ 6. Gossip fuels conflict and chaos Proverbs 26:20 “Without wood a fire goes out; without a gossip a quarrel dies down.” Why this matters: God is a God of peace, not disorder. Gossip keeps emotional fires burning long after they should have died. ⸻ 7. God links love for Him with control of the tongue** James 1:26 “Those who consider themselves religious and yet do not keep a tight rein on their tongues deceive themselves.” Why this matters: Scripture says unchecked speech—including gossip—undermines a person’s faith itself. ⸻ The big picture God condemns gossip because: 	•	It hurts people made in His image 	•	It breaks unity 	•	It reveals heart corruption 	•	It opposes love, truth, and peace And just to be clear: God hates gossip, not the gossiper. The repeated call of scripture is repentance, healing, and changed speech—not condemnation. #fyp #tiktok #jesuschrist #christiantiktok #bible
zh: 1. 神憎恶八卦，因为它破坏关系。箴言16:28“乖僻人播散纷争；传舌的，离间密友。”这为何重要：神看重合一与和睦。八卦悄无声息地使人分离——常常是那些曾彼此信任的人。从神的角度看，这种伤害是严重的，绝非小事。⸻ 2. 八卦被视为严重的罪，而非“小瑕疵”。罗马书1:29–30“装满了各样不义……谗毁的、背后说人的、怨恨神的、侮慢人的、狂傲的……”这为何重要：注意八卦与重大罪行并列。圣经没有轻看它，因为它反映的是败坏的心，而不仅仅是随口胡说。⸻ 3. 神要人为每句闲话负责。马太福音12:36“我告诉你们，凡人所说的闲话，当审判的日子，必要句句供出来。”这为何重要：八卦往往始于“闲聊”。耶稣说得清楚：话语并非中性。神非常在意人如何使用言语。⸻ 4. 八卦源于错误的内心状况。马太福音15:18–19“惟独出口的，是从心里发出来的……假见证、谤讟。”这为何重要：神看重的是内心。八卦不只是信息的问题——它揭示了说话者内心的嫉妒、骄傲、怨恨或苦毒。⸻ 5. 神命令我们说造就人的话，而非拆毁的话。以弗所书4:29“污秽的言语一句不可出口，只要随事说造就人的好话。”这为何重要：八卦不造就人。即使是真实的，如果它带来的是损害而非医治，就违背了神话语的标准。⸻ 6. 八卦助长纷争与混乱。箴言26:20“火缺了柴就必熄灭；无人传舌，争竞便止息。”这为何重要：神是和平的神，而非混乱的神。八卦让本该熄灭的情绪之火持续燃烧。⸻ 7. 神将对祂的爱与勒住舌头联系起来。雅各书1:26“若有人自以为虔诚，却不勒住他的舌头，反欺哄自己的心，这人的虔诚是虚的。”这为何重要：经文指出，不受约束的言语——包括八卦——会破坏一个人的信仰本身。⸻ 总览：神谴责八卦，因为：• 它伤害按祂形象所造的人 • 它破坏合一 • 它揭示内心的败坏 • 它与爱、真理和和平对立。并且要明确一点：神恨恶的是八卦的行为，而非传八卦的人。圣经反复呼召的是悔改、医治和改变的言语——而非定罪。

d: 🤔 Neuroscience suggests gossip can feel rewarding in the moment because sharing social information can activate the brain’s reward system, releasing dopamine. That temporary “high” is one reason gossip can become a habit. But there’s another side. Repeated negative speech keeps your attention focused on criticism, suspicion, and comparison. Over time, the brain strengthens the neural pathways it uses most. The more you rehearse negativity, the easier it becomes to think negatively. The Bible recognized this long before neuroscience. “A perverse person stirs up conflict, and a gossip separates close friends.” — Proverbs 16:28 “Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up according to their needs.” — Ephesians 4:29 Every conversation is shaping someone—including you. The words you repeat become the thoughts you reinforce. Choose words that heal instead of divide. #Neuroscience #BibleTruth #ChristianLiving #MindRenewal #Faith
zh: 神经科学表明，八卦在当下会让人感到愉悦，因为分享社交信息会激活大脑的奖励系统，释放多巴胺。这种短暂的快感是八卦成瘾的原因之一。但另一面是，反复的负面言论会让你的注意力集中在批评、猜疑和攀比上。久而久之，大脑会强化最常用的神经通路。你越习惯表达负面情绪，就越容易产生负面想法。《圣经》远在神经科学之前就认识到这一点：“乖僻人播散纷争，传舌的离间密友。”——箴言16:28“污秽的言语一句不可出口，只要随事说造就人的好话，叫听见的人得益处。”——以弗所书4:29 每一次对话都在塑造某个人——也包括你自己。你重复的话语，会成为你强化的想法。选择去治愈，而非去分裂的言语。

d: Artist Stefan Visan transforms simple everyday objects into surreal visual experiments. In this piece, a red pen is attached directly to the finger 🤭 of a white glove, turning the hand itself into a writing instrument.  The intervention is extremely simple🫪🫪🫪, yet the image becomes strangely physical: an invisible psychological state is translated into a mechanical gesture performed by the body. Visan often works this way, altering familiar objects through small and handmade interventions. #artist #art #avantgarde #niche #weird
zh: 艺术家斯特凡·维桑将简单的日常物品转化为超现实的视觉实验。在这件作品中，一支红笔被直接固定在白手套的手指上，将手本身变成了书写工具。这种干预极其简单，但画面却变得异常具有身体感：一种看不见的心理状态被转化为由身体完成的机械手势。维桑常常通过这种小而手工的干预方式，来改变熟悉的物品。

d: Viral, unggahan soal kucing berkostum di Jalan Tunjungan, Surabaya, Jawa Timur, dinarasikan dieksploitasi untuk donasi. Dugaan eksploitasi itu mencuat setelah pengunggah mengaku melihat sejumlah kucing dalam kondisi lemas dan tidur bersamaan saat berada di kawasan tersebut. Pemilik kucing, Bimo (30), membantah narasi pemberian obat bius. Ia juga mengatakan, uang dari pengunjung diberikan secara sukarela. “Jadi ngasih uang itu enggak wajib. Saya pun juga enggak maksa untuk ngasih. Misalnya ya dari 10 orang yang datang berfoto paling yang ngasih itu cuma 1-2 orang. Ya gak apa,” ujar Bimo, Kamis (24/9/2026). Setelah kasus viral, Satpol PP Surabaya meminta aktivitas membawa kucing tersebut dihentikan di Jalan Tunjungan. Sementara itu, Wali Kota Surabaya Eri Cahyadi melarang segala bentuk open donasi menggunakan hewan di tempat umum, seperti Jalan Tunjungan maupun saat kegiatan Car Free Day (CFD). 🎥: Kompas.com/Azwa Safrina Penulis: Azwa Safrina, Larissa Huda, Novianti Setuningsih Kreatif: Ria Rahayu Produser: Reza Kurnia Darmawan #Kucing #Peristiwa #Read [20260922170849679]
zh: 泗水Tunjungan街猫咪穿服装被指利用募捐事件引发关注。猫主人Bimo否认使用麻醉剂，称捐款纯属自愿。泗水城管队已叫停该活动，市长禁止在公共场所利用动物进行任何形式的公开募捐。

The Traditional Dance of Bali: Legong Explained Legong is one of Bali’s most iconic and sacred traditional dances, known for its intricate eye movements, graceful hand gestures, and deep cultural meaning. Unlike modern dance trends, Legong requires years of training, often starting as early as five years old. Originally performed by young girls in royal courts, the dance symbolizes purity, discipline, and spiritual devotion—often as an offering to the gods during temple ceremonies. Today, men are also learning Legong, helping to preserve and evolve this art form for future generations. Every movement in Legong tells a story, usually drawn from ancient Hindu epics, making it more than just a dance—it’s a living expression of Balinese identity and heritage.  #bali #culture #traditionaldance #traditional #culturalheritage #dance #folkdance #culturaldiversitycostume #shorts #interestingshorts #uniqueshorts

zh: 巴厘岛传统舞蹈：雷贡舞详解 雷贡舞是巴厘岛最具标志性和神圣性的传统舞蹈之一，以其复杂的眼神转动、优雅的手势和深厚的文化内涵而闻名。与现代舞蹈潮流不同，雷贡舞需要多年训练，往往从五岁就开始。最初由宫廷中的少女表演，这种舞蹈象征着纯洁、纪律和精神奉献，常作为寺庙仪式中对神灵的献礼。如今，男性也开始学习雷贡舞，有助于为后代保存和发展这门艺术。雷贡舞的每个动作都在讲述故事，多取材自古印度史诗，使其不仅仅是舞蹈，更是巴厘岛身份与传统的鲜活表达。

d: You’ve Never Seen Dance Moves Like This The Dero dance is a high-energy routine known for its wild, unpredictable movements and nonstop flow. At first glance it looks chaotic, but a closer look reveals rhythm, timing, and impressive control. Dancers groove with their whole body, following the beat in a way that feels both messy and skillful. In some communities, this style has been practiced for decades, keeping the tradition alive through festivals, gatherings, and friendly competitions. It’s a unique combination of fun, endurance, and cultural identity that continues to stand out today.  #derodance #indonesia #tradition #interesting #interestingfacts #knowledge

d: Masak tekwan di kebun sambil menikmati suasana hujan 🌧️🌿 Hari ini kami kembali masak-masak di pondok kebun. Apalagi makan tekwan hangat saat hujan, ditambah sedikit cabe biar makin pedas dan nikmat. 🌶️🤤 Suara hujan, udara dingin, dan semangkuk tekwan hangat di pondok kebun… sederhana, tapi bikin hati senang. Beuhhh… enak sekali! 😁 Teman-teman, ada yang suka makan tekwan juga? Tulis di komentar ya. #Tekwan #MasakanPagarAlam #KulinerPagarAlam #MasakanTradisional #MasakDiKebun
zh: 在园子里做鱼丸粿条汤，享受雨天的氛围 今天我们又回园子的小屋做饭了。因为一直在下雨，空气感觉挺冷的，我们就选了做热腾腾的鱼丸粿条汤一起吃。鱼丸粿条汤是巴嘎阿南常做的一种食物。不仅用料简单、容易做，味道也好，适合任何时候吃。尤其是下雨天吃一碗热热的鱼丸粿条汤，再加点辣椒，更辣更好吃。雨声，冷空气，和园中小屋里一碗热腾腾的鱼丸粿条汤……简简单单，却让人心里欢喜。哇……太好吃了！朋友们，也有人喜欢吃鱼丸粿条汤吗？在评论区告诉我吧。

Kalo aku sih tetap masak makanan Indonesia, tentunya minyak yang aku pakai SunCo Sebagus itu yang nempel enaknya bukan minyaknya. Apalagi SunCo 100% Minyak produk asli Indonesia🥰😍
zh: 辣牛肉干🥩🍛 每次参加完国庆比赛回家，我都特别容易饿。关键就是吃味道辛辣、咸香、美味、浓郁醇厚的印尼菜😍🥰 🔽食谱🔽 焖煮用料：1公斤牛肉、10瓣红葱头（磨成泥）、10瓣大蒜（磨成泥）、1汤匙罗望子酱、3片月桂叶、4根香茅、1块拇指大小的生姜、8片青柠叶、1汤匙香菜粉、半汤匙盐、1汤匙味精、1汤匙牛肉精粉、1.1升嫩椰水 研磨香料：12个大红辣椒、20个红卷辣椒、5个红小米椒、18瓣红葱头、4瓣大蒜 炒制香料：Sunco食用油、研磨好的香料、8片青柠叶、1茶匙牛肉精粉、1茶匙味精、半茶匙盐、1汤匙罗望子水 你们国庆节都干什么呀？我呢，还是做印尼菜，用的油当然是SunCo。好味道源自好食材，而不是油本身。更何况SunCo是100%印尼原产食用油🥰😍

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.
zh: 印尼炒饭 食材：3瓣大蒜（切碎）、1个鸡蛋、3杯熟米饭、4片鱼饼（切薄片）、4只大虾（去壳去虾线）、一把鲜鱿鱼（处理干净切片）、1汤匙生抽、2汤匙甜酱油、1茶匙黑焦糖酱、1汤匙参巴酱（依口味调整）、一大撮YumYum或味精、1根朝天椒（切细圈）、1根小葱（切薄片）、2汤匙炸蒜、黄瓜片和番茄片（配菜）、煎蛋（配菜） 步骤：1. 用大火烧热炒锅，加少量油。放入蒜末炒香。2. 打入鸡蛋并快速炒散，在蛋液凝固时将其拨成小块。3. 将熟米饭倒入锅中，充分翻炒，打散结块，确保米粒均匀裹上蛋液和蒜末。4. 加入鱼饼、虾和鱿鱼。一起翻炒，直到海鲜熟透。5. 加入生抽、甜酱油、黑焦糖酱和参巴酱。充分翻炒，让酱汁均匀裹在米饭和食材上。6. 加入朝天椒圈和葱花。快速翻炒均匀。7. 在米饭上撒上炸蒜，最后翻炒一次。8. 热腾腾地装盘，配上黄瓜片和番茄片，顶上放一个煎蛋。

d: Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

Cajun butter steak bites over parmesan mashed potatoes🥩🧈 recipe below: Cajun butter🧈 -4 tbsp unsalted softened butter  -1/2 tsp seasoned Cajun -1 tsp parsley -2 tsp minced garlic  -1 tsp lemon juice -1/2 tsp Dijon mustard  Mix until combined (optional: add red pepper flakes for spice) Cajun steak bites🥩 -trim 2 steaks of choice into 1 inch pieces -season with 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 1 tsp buttery steakhouse seasoning -let steaks rest before cooking to avoid chewy steak bites ** -cook in avocado oil on med/high heat -flip after 1-2 minutes  -reduce heat and stir in 2 tbsp Cajun butter -toss steak bites 1 additional minute  -remove steak and add asparagus  -season asparagus with lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, pepper, & Parmesan  creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes🥔 -peel 2 large gold potatoes  -dice into 1 inch cubes  -boil in salted water -drain water and mash -stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sour cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/2 tbsp butter, salt, pepper, & garlic powder  Assembly✨ -Add creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes to a bowl and top with Cajun butter steak bites🥩 Serve with asparagus, ciabatta, & garnish with parsley  #cooking #foodtiktok #fyp  #creatorsearchinsights #whatdoimakefordinner

d: Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

d: Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi 🍝 Creamy, cozy, and irresistibly delicious gnocchi with tender chicken, sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, and Parmesan😍 All you need is:  •Chicken breast •Gnocchi •Onion •Garlic •Sun-dried tomatoes •Tomato paste •Chicken broth •Heavy cream •Fresh spinach •Parmesan •Olive oil or butter •Salt •Black pepper •Smoked paprika •Dried garlic •Oregano How To Make: 1. Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, dried garlic, and oregano. Fry in oil or butter on both sides until golden. Remove, cut into bite-sized pieces, and set aside. 2. In the same pan, sauté finely chopped onion, garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes. Add tomato paste, mix, and cook for about 5 minutes. 3. Pour in the chicken broth. Add the chicken pieces, spinach, and heavy cream. 4. Add the gnocchi and simmer until the gnocchi are tender and the sauce is creamy. 5. Finish with grated Parmesan and serve hot. #marrymechicken #gnocchi #cozydinner #dinnerideas #easydinnerrecipes

d: Hot rice, spicy chicken, loads of garlic and chilli, Holy basil, then a crispy fried egg on top. Simple food, but when it’s done properly it’s honestly one of my favourite things to eat. This is my version at home. And before the Pad Kra Pao police come for me, I’m joking when I say it’s exactly like Thailand 😂 I just make it the way I like eating it salty, spicy, a little bit sweet, heaps of basil and enough sauce to get all through the rice. If you’re Thai or you make Pad Kra Pao better than me, tell me what I should change. I actually want to know.

zh: 凉拌捣蛋。食材：熟鸡蛋6个、红葱头30克、调味鱼露酱55克、鱼露5克、非漂白蔗糖5克、味精3克、辣椒粉5克、青柠3-4瓣、葱花、香菜碎、用于摆盘的生菜和烫青菜。做法：1. 将鸭蛋放入锅中，沸腾后计时约6-7分钟，煮熟后捞出放入凉水中冷却，剥壳备用。2. 加入调味鱼露酱、非漂白蔗糖、鱼露、味精，挤入青柠汁，搅拌均匀，将鸡蛋稍微捣碎，加入辣椒粉、葱花、香菜拌匀，盛入容器，撒上葱花、香菜，配生菜和烫青菜一起上桌。

d: Crispy Vietnamese Style Rolled Pork belly  Ingredients 5–6 lb skin-on pork belly Butcher’s twine Seasoning 2½ Tbsp fine sea salt 1 Tbsp + ½ tsp sugar 2 tsp MSG 2½ tsp garlic powder 2 tsp onion powder 2 tsp Chinese five-spice 2½ tsp ground white pepper 1¼ tsp ground black pepper 1 tsp annatto powder, optional Salted Boiling Water 1 liter water 30 g fine sea salt Instructions  1. Prepare the skin. Bring 1 liter water to a boil and dissolve in 30 g salt. Place the pork belly skin-side up and slowly pour the hot salted water over the skin only. This helps tighten the skin. Pat completely dry, then prick the skin all over. 2. Prepare the meat. Turn the pork skin-side down. Butterfly any thicker sections if needed so the belly is relatively even, then lightly score the meat in a crosshatch pattern. 3. Mix all of the seasonings together and rub evenly over the meat side only, working the seasoning into the scores. Keep the skin as clean and dry as possible. 4. Roll and dry. Roll the pork tightly into a cylinder and tie securely with butcher’s twine every 1–1½ inches. Place on a wire rack and refrigerate uncovered for 24 hours to thoroughly dry the skin. 5. Roast in a 285°F / 140°C convection oven for 3 hours, or until the center reaches 180–185°F / 82–85°C. 6. Remove from the oven and rest uncovered for 20–30 minutes. Increase the oven temperature to 465–480°F / 240–250°C. 7. Remove the twine. Lightly brush the pork belly with the rendered fat. Return it to the oven and roast for another 15–25 minutes, rotating as needed, until the skin is golden brown, blistered, and crispy. If necessary, finish under the broiler to crisp any remaining areas, watching closely to prevent burning. 8. Rest uncovered for 25–30 minutes and slice. #vietnamese #crispy #roastporkbelly
zh: 脆皮越南式烤猪肉卷食材：5-6 磅带皮猪五花肉，棉绳调料：2½ 汤匙细海盐，1 汤匙 + ½ 茶匙糖，2 茶匙味精，2½ 茶匙大蒜粉，2 茶匙洋葱粉，2 茶匙五香粉，2½ 茶匙白胡椒粉，1¼ 茶匙黑胡椒粉，1 茶匙安纳托粉（可选）咸沸水：1 升水，30 克细海盐步骤：1. 准备猪皮。将1升水烧开，溶入30克盐。将五花肉皮朝上，慢慢将热盐水只浇在猪皮上。这有助于收紧猪皮。完全拍干，然后在猪皮上扎孔。2. 处理肉。将五花肉皮朝下。如有需要，将较厚部分切开摊平，使整体厚薄均匀，然后在肉面浅浅地划上十字花刀。3. 将所有调料混合，均匀涂抹在肉的切面上，让调料渗入刀口。尽量保持猪皮干净干燥。4. 卷起并干燥。将猪肉紧紧卷成圆柱形，用棉绳每隔1-1½英寸绑紧。放在烤架上，不盖盖子，冷藏24小时，让猪皮彻底变干。5. 放入预热至285°F / 140°C的风扇烤箱烘烤3小时，或直到中心温度达到180-185°F / 82-85°C。6. 从烤箱取出，不盖盖子静置20-30分钟。将烤箱温度升至465-480°F / 240-250°C。7. 取下棉绳。在猪肉卷表面轻轻刷上烤出的油脂。放回烤箱再烤15-25分钟，期间按需转动，直到表皮金黄、起泡且酥脆。必要时可用上火炙烤那些仍未变脆的区域，需密切看管以防烤焦。8. 不盖盖子静置25-30分钟，然后切片。

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood
zh: 🇵🇭 菲律宾猪肉阿斗波 | 菲律宾美食圣经 – 第1集 我演绎的最具代表性的菲律宾菜之一——猪肉阿斗波！这个系列会展示所有菲律宾菜肴及其不同变体，把它当作你的菲律宾美食指南吧。评论告诉我接下来想看什么！ 食材： 猪肉阿斗波 - 1.2公斤五花肉（或自选部位） - 15–20瓣大蒜，切碎（可调整——越多越香） - 1个洋葱，切碎 - 500毫升猪肉高汤 - 190毫升酱油 - 100毫升甘蔗醋 - 3根长绿辣椒 - 4片月桂叶 - 1汤匙整粒胡椒 - 30克椰糖，切碎（甜度可调） - 食用油 配料 - 洋葱青蒜切片 - 酥脆蒜末 - 水煮蛋 步骤 - 将猪肉煎至各面微黄，盛出备用。 - 同一锅中，将大蒜炒至微金并散发香味。加入洋葱炒软。 - 把猪肉放回锅中，倒入猪肉高汤。加入酱油、醋、绿辣椒、月桂叶、胡椒粒和椰糖。 - 盖上锅盖，中火炖煮5-10分钟 **不要搅拌，让醋味充分挥发。 - 转小火炖1–2小时，直至猪肉软烂、汤汁浓稠。理想状态是猪肉几乎浸在自身油脂中，类似油封的效果 - 可选：如果要配鸡蛋，在出锅前2-3分钟加入溏心蛋，以保持流心质感 - 配热米饭享用，撒上酥脆蒜末和青蒜，旁边放一个全熟蛋。请慢用。

d: 🇵🇭🎄 Cheesy Corned Beef Lumpianada Craving something cheesy and satisfying? This Cheesy Corned Beef Lumpianada is perfect any time of day—whether it’s breakfast, lunch, or dinner! Made for easy pantry cravings, it now comes with long, juicy, meaty strands of corned beef that are less greasy and less salty. And of course, each bite is packed with cheese and corn—perfect for sharing this holiday season, snacking, or simply treating yourself! A big thanks to @Abi Marquez for the inspiration!  INGREDIENTS:  Corned Beef Lumpianada:  - 10-15 cloves of garlic, minced - 2 white onions, diced - Oil for frying - 2-4 cans of Libby’s Corned Beef 260g  - 1 cup of corn kernels - 1 tbsp of paprika  - 1 tbsp of chili flakes (to taste)  - Pepper - frozen fries, diced and fried - Lumpia wrappers - Cornstarch + flour slurry - Mozzarella Cilantro-Lime Sauce - 1 bunch of cilantro, chopped - ½ cup of mayo - 3/4 cup of yogurt  - 1-2 lime, juiced - Salt and pepper to taste *measurements are estimates. season w uour ❤️ INGREDIENTS:  - Sauté garlic and onions until fragrant, before adding in your Libby’s Corned Beef. Cook until slightly crispy and add corn - Season with paprika, chili flakes. Set aside. for filling later. - To make the sauce, add everything under Cilantro-Lime sauce, into a bowl and mix. Adjust to taste.  - Double wrap lumpia wrappers and seal w/your slurry. Add in your filling, top it with the fried potatoes, and mozzarella cheese. Fry at 165C for about 5 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. - Serve hot and enjoy! #LibbysKitangMahal #LibbysPH #CookingASMR #ASMR #CornedBeef
zh: 🇵🇭🎄 芝士牛肉春卷 想吃点芝士浓郁、让人满足的东西吗？这道芝士牛肉春卷一天中任何时候都适合——无论是早餐、午餐还是晚餐！专为满足想吃简单家常菜的欲望而做，用了长长的、多汁的肉丝牛肉，不那么油腻也不会过咸。当然，每一口都塞满了芝士和玉米——非常适合这个假期分享、当零食或犒劳自己！非常感谢 @Abi Marquez 给的灵感！ 食材： 牛肉春卷： - 10-15瓣大蒜，切碎 - 2个白洋葱，切丁 - 食用油 - 2-4罐 Libby's 牌牛肉罐头（260克装） - 1杯玉米粒 - 1汤匙红甜椒粉 - 1汤匙辣椒碎（依口味调整） - 胡椒粉 - 冷冻薯条，切丁并炸过 - 春卷皮 - 玉米淀粉+面粉糊 - 马苏里拉芝士 香菜青柠酱 - 1把香菜，切碎 - 半杯蛋黄酱 - 3

d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

d: Nilagang Baka (Filipino Beef and Vegetable Soup) A cozy, comforting soup of tender beef ribs simmered in a savory broth with hearty vegetables. Best enjoyed with steamed rice and a bit of fish sauce on the side. Ingredients * 4 lbs beef ribs, cut into single pieces * 1 large onion, halved * 1 Tbsp garlic powder * 1 Tbsp black pepper * 1 Tbsp kosher salt * 2–3 beef bouillon cubes * 8 cups water * 2–3 bay leaves * 2–3 ears yellow corn, cut into thirds * 2 russet potatoes, cut into large chunks * 1 bunch bok choy, cleaned and trimmed * 2 Tbsp fish sauce (or to taste) Instructions 1. Cook the Beef: In a pressure cooker or Instant Pot, combine beef ribs, onion, garlic powder, bouillon cubes, pepper, bay leaves, and water. Pressure cook on high for 15 minutes, then let it naturally release for another 15 minutes before opening the lid. No pressure cooker? Simmer on the stovetop for 2–3 hours until ribs are fork-tender. Add water if the broth reduces too much or becomes too salty. 2. Cook the Vegetables: While the beef is cooking, boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender (15–18 minutes). Add corn and simmer for another 5 minutes. Blanch bok choy for 1 minute and set aside. 3. Adjust the Broth: Once the beef is done, taste the broth. Adjust with more bouillon, salt, or fish sauce as needed. 4. Assemble and Serve: Add the cooked vegetables to the beef broth. Serve hot with steamed white rice and extra fish sauce on the side if desired. Enjoy! #nilagangbaka #bulalo #beefsoup #filipino #filipinofood #easyrecipe #easy #recipe #food #foodies #foodlover #dinner #lunch #dinnerideas #lunchideas

zh: 牛肉蔬菜汤 一道温暖舒心的汤品，嫩牛排在鲜美肉汤中与丰盛蔬菜一起慢炖。最好搭配米饭享用，旁边配点鱼露。食材：4磅牛排骨，切成单块 / 1个大洋葱，对半切开 / 1汤匙大蒜粉 / 1汤匙黑胡椒 / 1汤匙粗盐 / 2–3块牛肉高汤块 / 8杯水 / 2–3片月桂叶 / 2–3根黄玉米，切成三段 / 2个褐土豆，切大块 / 1捆上海青，洗净修剪 / 2汤匙鱼露（或根据口味添加）。做法：1. 炖牛肉：在高压锅中放入牛排骨、洋葱、大蒜粉、高汤块、胡椒、月桂叶和水。高压煮15分钟，然后自然泄压15分钟再开盖。如果没有高压锅，用普通锅炖2–3小时，直到排骨软烂。如果汤太少或太咸，可以加水。2. 煮蔬菜：煮牛肉时，将土豆在盐水中煮至软烂（15–18分钟）。加入玉米再煮5分钟。将上海青焯水1分钟，捞出备用。3. 调整汤味：牛肉炖好后，尝尝味道。按需加入更多高汤块、盐或鱼露调味。4. 装盘上菜：将煮好的蔬菜加入牛肉汤中。趁热搭配白米饭享用，喜欢的话旁边可放些鱼露。

d: 🇵🇭 Ilocos Empanada | Filipino Food Bible Episode 4 A crispy pocket of goodness filled with sausage, egg and papaya originating from Ilocos in the northern region of the Philippines. Many variations exist but this is my take inspired by both the Vigan and Batac versions! note: adjust ratios of water/flour depending on flour brand since absorption rates may vary. Measurements are weighed but adjust to your preference! INGREDIENTS: Vigan Longganisa/sausage: - 1kg ground pork - 170g of garlic, minced - 80 ml spiced cane vinegar - 80 ml soy sauce - 2-3 tsp of ground black pepper - 1 tbsp of brown sugar - Salt to taste - pinch of MSG Spiced Vinegar: - 15-20 cloves garlic - 3 green chili - 9 birds eye chili - 15 shallots - 700 ml cane vinegar - 1 tbsp freshly cracked black pepper - 1 tsp salt - 30 ml fish sauce Dough (Yield 7-8 ~110g per ball): - 340g rice flour - 2 cups water - pinch of salt - 1 1/2 tbsp of chicken powder - 2 1/2 tbsp of annatto powder - 4 tbsp oil  Filling: - 2:1 ratio shredded green papaya to mung beans - salt/pepper to taste INSTRUCTIONS:  - for spiced vinegar blend together all ingredients under "spiced vinegar”. set aside - For the sausage, combine all ingredients listed under "Vigan longganisa” mix and let sir for 1hr - overnight  . Sear until rendered and crispy. - soak beans for about 1-2 hrs. Drain and boil for ~15mins until soft. - Shred papaya, add salt. squeeze water out. Combine w/ munggo and season w salt and pepper. - For the dough combine annatto powder, oil, salt, chicken powder and water. Boil and add to flour. knead until the texture resembles clay. you can combine w/ flour directly on stovetop. - roll ball of dough between cut plastic until thin - In the center place your papaya mixture and form a small hollow circle. add sausage, and egg at the center - Fold, tuck in the sides, and cut excess dough using a plate. Fry at 165C until crispy - Serve w/ spiced vinegar and enjoy! #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr

d: 🇵🇭 Beef Salpicao | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 12 My take on a delicious FIlipino-Spanish dish usually made with tender beef cubes cooked in garlic, butter and Worcestershire sauce — but with extra garlic flavor!  * this recipe is only a guideline. most ingredients are just estimates so taste and adjust with your ❤️ INGREDIENTS: Beef salpicao: - 500g ribeye steak (or any cut of steak of your choice) - 300g of button mushrooms - Salt and pepper to taste - Oil for frying - 1/4 block of butter - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - 3 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce  - 1  tbsp of oyster sauce  - 2 tbsp of paprika  Garlic confit: - 300g of peeled garlic cloves - Olive Oil to cover Garnish: - parsley - crunchy garlic - pickled peppers INSTRUCTIONS: - Start by seasoning your steak and grilling until medium rare. Slice them into bite sized chunks and set aside for later - Slice button mushrooms. In a pan , add oil and/or butter, sauté the button mushrooms until they get deeper in color. Season with salt and pepper.  - Add minced garlic to a hot pan with oil and butter, and saute unti fragrant. Add back your steak and mushroom and add Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, paprika and black pepper. - To make it extra garlicky, we’re adding some garlic confit. To make it, simply add peeled garlic to a pot, cover with oil, and cook low and slow until the cloves are soft and golden. - Serve with garlic rice and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR # FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

Episode 5: Homemade Garlic Longganisa 🇵🇭 (Pinoy-Style) Ingredients:  900 g ground pork 150 g pork fat (optional) 20 cloves garlic, finely minced 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp white vinegar 1 tsp paprika 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tbsp salt 1 tbsp black pepper Natural hog casing  Kitchen twine Procedure:  1. Rinse and soak the hog casing in water for 1 minute. Drain well. 2. Mix the ground pork, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika, cornstarch, and cold water until sticky and well combined. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours 3. Stuff the mixture into the casing, being careful not to overfill. Twist and tie with kitchen twine. 4. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight to slightly dry the casing. Then freeze overnight. 4. To cook, place the longganisa in a pan with ¼ cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat until the water evaporates. Add 1–2 tbsp oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through, reaching 71°C / 160°F internally. You can add any seasoning but make sure you mix it well with the meat! Pwede adobo flavor or any. Enjoy my recipe and tag me pag nakagawa na kayo! ☺️ #ChefYlyt #privatechef #easyrecipes #homemade #longganisa

Ginataang Manok  Ingredients: 4 Chicken thighs and 4-6 drumsticks Kosher salt for seasoning the chicken 1/2 onion, sliced 3 cloves garlic, minced 3/4 Cup water 2 Cans coconut milk 1 Anaheim Pepper 3 Fresno chillies (optional) use 1-2 Thai chili if you like it spicy 1 Chicken Bouillon Cube 1 Tbsp Black pepper 1 Tbsp Fish sauce 40g Ginger, cut in slices 1 Large potato 1 Large Carrot Bok Choy Instructions 1. Season the chicken generously with kosher salt. For the best flavor, refrigerate and let it season overnight. 2. Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken skin-side down until golden brown and the fat has rendered, about 5–7 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 more minute, then remove from the pot. 3. In the same pot, sauté the onions for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Pour in the water and coconut milk, then stir in the ginger, bouillon cube, fish sauce, and black pepper. Return the chicken to the pot. 5. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. 6. Add the potatoes, carrots, and Fresno chilies (if using). Continue simmering for another 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are fork-tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Taste the broth and adjust the seasoning if needed. 8. Serve hot with steamed white rice. #ginataangmanok #filipino #recipe #food #easyrecipe

d: lazy girl bistek tagalog 🧅🥩 serves 1-2 ingredients: * ½ lb (225g) thinly sliced, slightly fatty beef brisket * 2 tbsp soy sauce * 1½ tbsp lemon juice (or calamansi juice) * 2 cloves garlic, minced * ⅓–½ tsp brown sugar, or to taste * 1 large onion, sliced into rings * 2 tbsp butter * cooked white rice, for serving directions: 1. Marinate the thinly sliced brisket with soy sauce, lemon/calamansi juice, garlic and brown sugar for 10-15 minutes. 2. While it marinates, melt butter in a pan and sauté the onion rings until softened and lightly golden. Remove and set aside. 3. Cook the beef in the same pan until browned and cooked through. 4. zh: 懒人版菲律宾牛肉牛排 1-2人份 食材： * 225克薄切略带肥肉的牛胸肉 * 2汤匙酱油 * 1.5汤匙柠檬汁（或菲律宾青柠汁） * 2瓣蒜，切末 * 1/3–1/2茶匙红糖 * 1个大洋葱，切圈 * 2汤匙黄油 * 白米饭，供食用 步骤： 1. 将薄切牛胸肉用酱油、柠檬汁、蒜末和红糖腌制10-15分钟。 2. 腌制期间，在锅中融化黄油，将洋葱圈炒至变软并呈浅金色。盛出备用。 3. 在同一锅中将牛肉煎至焦黄熟透。 4. 让酱汁稍微收浓。 5. 将洋葱倒回锅中，翻炒均匀，浇在米饭上。 小贴士：薄切牛胸肉无需长时间腌制，带点肥肉的部位能保持牛肉多汁。

Easy Pork Salpicao Recipe | Pinoy Style Ingredients: 	•	1 kg pork kasim (cut into strips) 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	¼ cup oyster sauce 	•	1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	•	½ tsp ground black pepper 	•	1 tsp smoked paprika 	•	Minced garlic (about 1 bulb or more) 	•	Garlic powder (optional) 	•	¼ cup butter 	•	2 bulbs garlic (for frying) 	•	2 cans whole mushrooms (halved) 	•	Coconut oil (for frying) 	•	Water as needed ⸻ Instructions: 	1.	Marinate: Combine pork, soy sauce, oyster sauce, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, smoked paprika, minced garlic, and garlic powder (optional). Marinate for at least 30 minutes or longer for better flavor. 	2.	Fry the Garlic: In a pan, heat oil and fry 2 bulbs of minced garlic until golden brown. Remove and set aside for topping. 	3.	Cook the Pork: In the same pan, add a bit of coconut oil and ¼ cup butter. Sauté the marinated pork until browned. Add a bit of water and simmer until tender. 	4.	Add Mushrooms: Stir in the halved mushrooms and the fried garlic. Simmer until the sauce reduces and oil starts to render. 	5.	Serve: Top with more fried garlic and serve hot with steamed rice #pork #recipe #salpicao #yummy #foodie

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

d: Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv
zh: 奶油卡真鸡肉意面，一锅搞定，20分钟内上桌……多汁的卡真鸡肉配上最丝滑的蒜香帕玛森芝士酱。如果你厨房里只能有一口锅，那必须是@Made In Cookware 的酱汁锅！这口锅能胜任酱汁锅的一切工作，而且更出色！如果你想升级厨具，我在个人简介里链接了我最喜欢的Made In锅具。鸡肉部分：2大块鸡胸肉（拍扁），调味料：1汤匙辣椒粉，2茶匙蒜粉，2茶匙洋葱粉，2茶匙意大利混合香料，2茶匙盐，2茶匙黑胡椒，1-2茶匙卡宴辣椒粉（可选），1汤匙橄榄油。意面和酱汁部分：8盎司（225克）通心粉，3汤匙黄油，1大颗红葱头（切细丁），6-8瓣大蒜（切碎），1杯室温重奶油，调味料：1茶匙鸡精粉，1茶匙辣椒粉，1茶匙蒜粉，1茶匙意大利混合香料，1茶匙黑胡椒，3/4杯现磨帕玛森芝士（请一定用新鲜的！），半杯意面水（视需要而定，也就是液体黄金）。步骤：1. 将鸡肉拍干并捶打至均匀厚度。裹上1汤匙橄榄油，然后两面撒上调味料。2. 在盐水中煮意面至接近弹牙口感。捞出前至少保留半杯意面水。将意面捞出备用。3. 用中火加热大煎锅或锅几分钟。加入2汤匙橄榄油，调至中高火，放入鸡肉。每面煎3-4分钟至金黄，然后必要时调低火候，将鸡肉煎熟。夹出静置。4. 调至中火。在同一口锅里融化黄油，刮起锅底焦香物。加入红葱头煮5分钟，加入大蒜再煮1分钟。5. 调至中低火，慢慢倒入奶油。加入调味料，炖煮2-3分钟。调至低火，加入帕玛森芝士搅拌至顺滑。6. 加入意面和1/4杯意面水，低火翻拌1-2分钟至酱汁包裹住所有意面。视需要加入更多意面水。将鸡肉切片，铺在意面上，最后撒上更多帕玛森芝士和新鲜欧芹！

d: Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

d: Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing 1 cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles. I used yakisoba noodles brand is Fortune. Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Save this one for an easy weeknight dinner! 🍜🔥 #crockpotrecipes #crockpot #EasyRecipe #hawaiitiktok #mongolianbeef

d: Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

d: Cheesy Buldak Carbonara Noodles 🍝  Ingredients 1 pack Buldak Carbonara noodles 2–3 tbsp heavy cream 2 tbsp Kewpie mayo 1–2 tsp chili oil  2 cloves garlic, minced 2–3 tbsp green onions, chopped Mozzarella cheese (as much as you like) Spam, sliced into hearts Butter (for cooking) Dumplings (optional, for topping) Recipe Start by heating butter in a pan over medium heat. Add the spam hearts and cook until golden and slightly crispy on both sides. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, add minced garlic, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, powder and green onions. Mix everything together until smooth and creamy. Pour in the heavy cream and mix well. Let it simmer for a minute until slightly thickened. Add your cooked noodles and toss well until fully coated in the creamy spicy sauce. Spread mozzarella cheese over the top, cover, and let it melt until gooey and stretchy. Top with dumplings, spam hearts, an extra drizzle of chili oil, and more green onions. Serve hot and enjoy that perfect 3am comfort bowl  . #buldak #buldakramen #food #Foodie #eat
zh: 芝士火鸡奶油意面，食材：1包火鸡奶油面、2-3大匙淡奶油、2大匙Kewpie蛋黄酱、1-2小匙辣油、2瓣蒜切末、2-3大匙葱花、马苏里拉芝士适量、心形午餐肉片、黄油适量、饺子可选作为顶料。做法：中火融化黄油，将心形午餐肉煎至两面金黄微脆盛出备用。同锅加入蒜末、Kewpie蛋黄酱、辣油、火鸡面酱包、粉包和葱花，搅匀至顺滑，倒入淡奶油拌匀，炖煮一分钟至稍浓稠，放入煮好的面条充分裹上酱汁，铺上马苏里拉芝士，加盖焖至拉丝融化，放上饺子、午餐肉心形片，再淋少许辣油和葱花，趁热享用，完美的凌晨暖心碗面

d: Don't Play This | Full Playthrough of Tape 1 with No Commentary Gameplay | Psychological Horror The title of this game is literally a warning. In this playthrough, we step into the first of five terrifying scenarios in Don't Play This, an intense psychological horror walking simulator developed by Admia, a1esska, and Notex. The game reconstructs the final moments of different people's lives through strange video recordings that someone keeps sending to us. This first scenario immediately sets the tone with its suffocating atmosphere, heavy reliance on environmental dread, and incredibly tense sound design. We are forced to navigate the space and survive long enough to piece together the dark reality of what ended this specific tape forever. We will be checking out the remaining four recordings in upcoming videos to see exactly how this overarching nightmare unfolds. #gaming #gameplay #horrorgame #indiegames #tiesthatbindgaming
zh: 千万别玩 | 第一卷完整通关流程，无解说 | 心理恐怖游戏 这个游戏的名字本身就是个警告。本次通关将进入《千万别玩》五个恐怖场景中的第一个。这是一款由Admia、a1esska和Notex开发的沉浸式心理恐怖步行模拟器。游戏通过有人不断寄给我们的奇怪录像，重构了不同人生命最后的时刻。第一个场景立刻奠定了基调：令人窒息的氛围、高度依赖环境恐惧的渲染、以及极其紧绷的音效设计。我们被迫在其中穿行并存活足够长的时间，以拼凑出这盘录像带被永久终结的黑暗真相。我们会在后续视频中体验剩下的四段录像，看看这个贯穿始终的噩梦究竟如何展开。

d: You hear your name outside at night. Once. Then silence. A few minutes later, the voice comes from a different side of the house — but nobody knocks, nobody rings, nobody explains why they’re there. Then the voice stops completely. And that’s when you hear three slow knocks. Not from the front door. From somewhere inside the house. If you ever genuinely suspect someone has entered your home, don’t search for them yourself. Leave through a safe exit if possible and contact emergency services. Some sounds are scary because you don’t know what made them. This one is worse because it knows your name. #Creepypasta #AnalogHorror #VHS #NightHorror #ScaryStories
zh: 夜里屋外有人喊你的名字，喊了一声就安静了。几分钟后，声音从房子的另一侧传来——但没人敲门，没人按铃，没人解释为什么在那里。然后声音完全停止。这时你听到三下缓慢的敲击声，不是从大门传来，而是从屋里某处。如果你真的怀疑有人闯入，不要自己去搜查，尽可能从安全出口离开并联系紧急服务。有些声音可怕是因为你不知道是什么发出的，而这个更糟，因为它知道你的名字。

Dinner #1 from my $50 grocery haul 🍴 Tonight we're making a One Pan Smoked Sausage Broccoli & Cheddar Pasta. This recipe is a great example of how I approach budget cooking. Instead of buying butter, flour, milk, and several seasonings to make a cheese sauce from scratch, we're using a jar of alfredo sauce as a creamy, pre-seasoned base and transforming it into a broccoli cheddar sauce with a little cheese and some smoked sausage. The goal isn't to make the fanciest dinner possible. The goal is to make a dinner that's affordable, easy to follow, family-friendly, and made with ingredients that can be used throughout the week. And honestly? This one tastes way more expensive than it is. #budgetmeals #cheapmeals #familydinner #mealplanning #dinnerideas
zh: 50美元采购的晚餐：今晚做一锅烟熏香肠西兰花切达意面。这道菜很好体现我的省钱烹饪思路：不用单独买黄油、面粉、牛奶和一堆调料去做奶酪酱，我们用一罐阿尔弗雷多酱作奶油基底，加点奶酪和烟熏香肠，就变成西兰花切达酱。目标不是做最花哨的晚餐，而是做一顿实惠、简单、全家爱吃、食材还能用一周的饭。说实话，它吃起来比实际成本贵得多。

d: My name is Justin, I’m glad you’re here Steak Stir Fry -2 Strip Steaks cut into bite sized pieces -4 eggs -4 cups day old rice -1 bag frozen stir fry mix veggies -Teriyaki sauce too taste -Garlic and butter seasoning to taste -2 tsp’s MSG -1 tbsp sesame oil -3 tbsps high heat cooking oil -(optional)sesame seeds, Japanese bbq sauce, yum yum sauce to garnish Preheat oil in wok at medium high heat Season steak with garlic butter seasoning using teriyaki sauce as a binder Heat frozen veggies to almost done in microwave or in steamer and set aside Add steak to pan and cook til almost done Remove from pan and add eggs Scramble til cooked making sure to keep eggs moving so not to burn Add rice mixing constantly so not to burn eggs in pan Add sesame oil, teriyaki sauce, msg and additional garlic butter seasoning if desired (I usually add 1 tbsp of teriyaki mix for a minute and add more til desired color on rice is achieved) Return steak to pan, turn off heat and stir til mixed Serve hot, optional garnish with green onion, sesame seeds, yum yum sauce, hot honey, Japanese bbq sauce, or whatever you love to eat your stir fry with  #steakfriedrice #griddle #dinner #mealideas #holmescooking
zh: 我叫Justin，欢迎你来 牛排炒饭 -2块Strip牛排，切小块 -4个鸡蛋 -4杯隔夜饭 -1袋冷冻炒菜杂蔬 -照烧酱 适量 -蒜香黄油调味料 适量 -2茶匙味精 -1汤匙芝麻油 -3汤匙耐高温食用油 -(可选)芝麻、日式烧烤酱、yum yum酱作点缀 中高火预热炒锅 用蒜香黄油调味料腌制牛排，照烧酱作粘合剂 微波炉或蒸锅加热冷冻蔬菜至快熟，备用 牛排入锅煎至快熟 出锅，加入鸡蛋 翻炒至熟，不断搅拌防粘锅 加入米饭，不停搅拌防粘锅 加入芝麻油、照烧酱、味精和额外的蒜香黄油调味料（我通常加1汤匙照烧酱，翻炒一分钟，再加至米饭上色满意） 牛排回锅，关火拌匀 趁热享用，可选葱花、芝麻、yum yum酱、辣蜂蜜、日式烧烤酱或任何你喜欢的炒饭酱料点缀

d: Recipe👇🏽 Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks Just Got Crispier🌶️🔥 These mozzarella sticks just got a serious upgrade. Double-breaded, fried until golden and crispy, then tossed in a Nashville hot oil that brings the heat. Mozzarella Sticks 3 rectangles low-moisture mozzarella, sliced into ½–1 inch sticks Flour, for dusting 2 eggs, beaten 1½ cups breadcrumbs Oil, for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp brown sugar Slice the low-moisture mozzarella into ½–1 inch sticks and lightly dust them in flour. Freeze for 1 hour. Dip the frozen mozzarella into the egg, then breadcrumbs, then back into the egg and breadcrumbs again. Heat your oil to 350°F and fry the mozzarella straight from frozen for 2–3 minutes, until golden and crispy. You’ll know they’re ready when they float to the top and look nice and puffy. Don’t overcrowd the pan. While they’re frying, mix the Nashville hot oil ingredients together. As soon as the mozzarella sticks come out, brush or toss them in the hot oil while they’re still steaming. Serve immediately with ranch. I hope it crunches.
zh: 食谱👇🏽 纳什维尔辣味马苏里拉芝士棒，更酥脆了🌶️🔥 双层裹粉，炸至金黄酥脆，再裹上纳什维尔辣油。 马苏里拉芝士棒 3块低水分马苏里拉芝士，切成1.3-2.5厘米宽的长条 面粉，适量 鸡蛋2个，打散 面包糠1.5杯 食用油，炸制用 纳什维尔辣油 热油炸用油半杯 卡宴辣椒粉2汤匙 红椒粉1茶匙 大蒜粉1茶匙 红糖1汤匙 马苏里拉芝士切条，薄裹面粉。冷冻1小时。 冻好的芝士条依次蘸蛋液、面包糠，再重复一次。 油温加热至350°F，从冷冻状态直接下锅炸2到3分钟，至金黄酥脆，浮起且饱满即可。 不要一次放太多。 炸制时，把纳什维尔辣油的材料混合好。 芝士棒一出锅，趁热刷上或裹上辣油。 立即配牧场蘸酱上桌。希望吃起来嘎嘣脆。

d: Fall Gameday Comfort Food Series Part 7: Crispy Cajun Chicken Sausage Pasta Recipe👇: Ingredients • Chicken breast • Andouille sausage • Rigatoni • Red bell pepper • Green bell pepper • Onion • Garlic • Butter • Cajun seasoning • Tomato paste • Chicken broth • Heavy cream • Parmesan • Pasta water • Flour • Eggs • Breadcrumbs • Parsley • Olive oil Instructions 1. Sear the andouille until charred, then remove. 2. Add butter, peppers, onion and garlic. Cook until softened, then add the sausage back in. 3. Add Cajun seasoning and tomato paste, then chicken broth and heavy cream. Simmer until thickened. 4. Add cooked rigatoni and Parmesan. Use pasta water as needed until creamy. 5. Coat the chicken in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan and parsley. 6. Fry in olive oil until golden brown and cooked through, then slice. 7. Plate the Cajun sausage rigatoni, top with sliced chicken cutlet and finish with parsley and Parmesan. #pasta #cajun #chicken #dinner #recipe

this viral oreo bark is about to be your new favorite little treat after dinner 🍫🤍 Ingredients: 1 pack @OREO double stuf sandwich cookies 1 bag mini marshmallows 1 stick butter 6 @Hershey's cookies ‘n’ creme bars @jetpuffed marshmallow bits mini oreo cookies Instructions: On a parchment-lined baking sheet, arrange oreo cookies in an even layer. Microwave mini marshmallows and butter in 30-second intervals, stirring between until smooth. Pour the marshmallow mixture over the cookies and spread it evenly. Microwave chocolate bars in 30-second intervals until smooth, then spread over the marshmallow layer. Sprinkle with mini oreo cookies and marshmallow bits. Allow to chill in fridge for at least 30 minutes or until set, then slice or break into pieces and enjoy! 😋 #oreo #recipe #dessert #tiktokfood #creatorsearchinsights

d: Would you actually eat this street food? 😳 In this wild street food compilation, we explore some of the most unbelievable street food scenes from around the world. From massive woks full of noodles to busy street vendors cooking huge portions right in front of customers, this video shows the reality of street food markets and street food cooking that millions of people enjoy every day. Street food is famous for its bold flavors, fast cooking, and incredible variety. In many countries, street vendors prepare delicious meals in giant pans, sizzling grills, and steaming pots right on the street. But sometimes the cooking conditions can look a little questionable… which raises the big question — would you actually eat this street food? 🍜🔥 This street food video shows everything from huge noodle stir-fries and sizzling wok cooking to intense street kitchen action where vendors prepare food quickly for long lines of hungry customers. Street food markets are full of energy, heat, flames, and nonstop cooking that makes these food scenes fascinating to watch. Whether you love street food, enjoy food documentaries, or just want to see some unbelievable cooking moments, this street food compilation will definitely make you think twice. Some of these street food scenes look delicious… while others might make you wonder if you would really try it! 🤯 Let us know in the comments — would YOU eat this street food? 👇  #streetfood​ #shorts​ #food​
zh: 你真敢吃这种街头小吃吗？在这段疯狂的街头美食集锦中，我们探索了世界各地一些最令人难以置信的街头美食场景。从装满面条的巨大炒锅，到忙碌的街头摊贩在顾客面前现场烹饪大量食物，这个视频展示了数百万人每天都在享受的街头美食市场和街头烹饪的真实情况。街头美食以其大胆的口味、快速的烹饪和惊人的多样性而闻名。在许多国家，街头摊贩就在街上用巨大的平底锅、滋滋作响的铁板和热气腾腾的锅烹制美味佳肴。但有时烹饪条件可能看起来有点令人存疑……这就引出了一个大问题——你真敢吃这种街头小吃吗？这段街头美食视频展示了从海量炒面、滋滋作响的炒锅烹饪，到摊贩为排着长队的饥饿顾客快速备餐的紧张街头厨房运作。街头美食市场充满了能量、高温、火焰和不间断的烹饪，使这些美食场景令人着迷。无论你是喜欢街头小吃、享受美食纪录片，还是只想看一些令人难以置信的烹饪瞬间，这段街头美食集锦绝对会让你三思。其中一些街头美食场景看起来很美味……而另一些可能会让你怀疑自己是否真的愿意尝试！在评论区告诉我们——你愿意吃这种街头小吃吗？
